rule: Each trader is ONE hypothesis at ONE horizon H fixed in advance (1 day trader, 60 long-term, else 20 sessions). Entry: the first regular-session open after the call was public (New York). FOLLOW: 30+ finished calls on 10+ days; both halves positive after 0.8% and 1.2% and beating the average stock; positive without his 2 best; date-clustered t vs the average stock >= 2.5. FADE: same counts, worse in both halves, t <= -2.5, still worse without his 2 worst. WATCH: too few.

unreached.X: needs data: X API read access is paid (Basic tier, about 200 USD a month); with a bearer token in an X_BEARER secret, the users/:id/tweets endpoint gives the same dated calls.
unreached.Reddit: needs data: the Reddit API needs an app the owner registers (reddit.com/prefs/apps, script type, free for personal non-commercial use); with REDDIT_ID / REDDIT_SECRET secrets, /user/<name>/submitted gives dated posts.
unreached.Discord: needs data: Discord has no public read API; a bot can read only servers that invite it (the owner would need admin consent in each trading server).
unreached.TikTok: needs data: TikTok’s Research API is for approved academic researchers only; no other official read access to videos.
unreached.Kinfo: not reached: Kinfo (broker-verified trader journals) has no public API; its leaderboards are inside the app behind an account, so reading them would need a login. Unlock: Kinfo would have to grant API or export access.
